Dynamic but friendly to children and adults. No people, faces, masks, thief motifs, existing game logos, city skyline, text, letters, numerals, watermark, strobe patterns or copied album imagery. Avoid square mosaic tiles; this cover's identity is flowing split jetstream bands. High-resolution square PNG.
